toegepas.voor: Ander flesse se lang nek, gebuig soos 'n swaan s'n, het lug ingelaat en die stoffies vasgevang.
toegepas.na: By ander flesse was die lang nek gebuig soos 'n swaan s'n. Die nek het lug ingelaat en die stoffies vasgevang.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The possessive with a parenthetical participle is wooden for Grade 6; two short sentences mirror the preceding 'By party flesse' and keep the meaning.
toegepas.fout: A possessive subject with a parenthetical participle between it and its verb ('Ander flesse se lang nek, gebuig soos ...') is stiff and makes a Grade 6 reader stumble.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two short sentences parallel 'By party flesse' and keep the same flasks, neck shape and actions, with no protected wording touched.

toegepas.voor: Daar het dieselfde vloeistof skoon gebly.
toegepas.na: In dié flesse het dieselfde vloeistof skoon gebly.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Daar' has no clear place to point back to after a sentence about the neck; naming the flasks makes the reference unambiguous.
toegepas.fout: 'Daar' has no clear antecedent after a sentence about the neck, so it could point at the neck rather than the flasks.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the flasks makes the reference unambiguous and changes nothing in the claim.

toegepas.voor: Daarna hou die melk langer en is dit veiliger om te drink.
toegepas.na: Daarna hou die melk langer, en is dit veiliger om te drink.
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb (die melk hou; dit is), so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subject and verb ('hou die melk' and 'is dit').
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma is required by AWS 2017 and leaves the wording untouched.
